samples.summary: No guard-level test pins that GOOGLE_CALLBACK_URL cannot open the CLI-login gate
searchedFor: read github-auth.guard.spec.ts describe('cliLoginAvailable') and describe('CLI login availability')
samples.evidence: The delta's stated point is that Google's callback URL must move none of `useSecureCookies()`'s consumers, singling out `cliLoginAvailable()` and `insecureProductionOrigin()` (oauth-state.ts doc, github-auth.guard.ts:250-252). Coverage for that lives only in oauth-state.spec.ts:168 at the `useSecureCookies()` level. github-auth.guard.spec.ts never sets or clears GOOGLE_CALLBACK_URL at all — its env-pinning object (lines 75-79) and both `cliLoginAvailable`/`insecureProductionOrigin` suites (lines 487-491, 549-553) list only NODE_ENV, GITHUB_CALLBACK_URL and COOKIE_SECURE — so if the Google read were reintroduced at the gate (or the gate were rewired to read it directly rather than through `useSecureCookies()`), no test in the guard suite would fail, and a developer .env with GOOGLE_CALLBACK_URL would silently decide these cases instead of failing them.

samples.summary: Half of the merged 'ignores GOOGLE_CALLBACK_URL' test asserts nothing the previous implementation did not already satisfy
samples.evidence: In `ignores GOOGLE_CALLBACK_URL in both directions` (line 168), the second leg (NODE_ENV=production + http Google URL -> `useSecureCookies()===true`) passed under the removed upgrade-only implementation too (that code only returned true for an https Google URL and otherwise fell through to the NODE_ENV fallback), and it duplicates `falls back to NODE_ENV when no callback URL is configured` (line 198). Only the first leg (development + https Google URL -> false) actually discriminates the behaviour this delta changed. The test is not vacuous overall, but its second half carries no regression value for this diff.

samples.summary: useSecureCookies cases leave COOKIE_SECURE/GOOGLE_CALLBACK_URL unset from the ambient environment
samples.evidence: `follows the GitHub callback URL when both are set` (renamed by this delta) sets both callback URLs but never deletes COOKIE_SECURE, which `isSecureCookie()` reads first; the same applies to lines 128 and 137. A developer shell or packages/backend/.env with COOKIE_SECURE=true makes these expectations fail locally while passing in CI — the sibling tests at lines 169-170 and 199-201 do clear it, so the pattern is inconsistent rather than deliberate.
